abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **^^SHOOT^^** and/or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Astral Compass
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the **HUNTED** keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Star-marked
abilities.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while a **HUNTED** enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks that target a **HUNTED** enemy unit.

abilities.effect:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:
**DPP Effect**
**1** This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.
**2** This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
**3** This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^SPELLS^^**, **^^PRAYERS^^** and abilities used by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**. Otherwise, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible **^^MANIFESTATION^^** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. 
The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **^^SUMMON^^** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Firing from the Belly
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a **^^MOVE^^** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Powder Gnoblars
abilities.effect:
This unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** are tokens. There are 2 **Powder Gnoblars** for every 4 models in this unit.
Each time this unit uses a **^^SHOOT^^** ability, for each of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** from the battlefield after that **^^SHOOT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Arcane Enhancement
abilities.effect:
While the unit that was picked to be the target of the 'Summon Dais Arcanum' ability is on the platform of this **^^MANIFESTATION^^**:
• That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** and **^^FLY^^**.
• If that unit is a **^^WIZARD^^**, add 1 to that unit's power level.
• That unit cannot use **^^MOVE^^** abilities and remains on this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** each time it moves.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to and from that unit, measure to and from this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** instead.
• This **^^MANIFESTATION^^** cannot be picked to be the target of abilities other than **^^BANISH^^** abilities.
• If that unit is picked to make a pile-in move, move this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** instead.
If this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** is banished, before removing it from the battlefield, set up the unit on its platform on the battlefield within 3" of it. That unit can only be set up in combat with units it was already in combat with when this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** was banished. If it is not possible to set up that unit, it is destroyed.
If the unit on the platform is removed from the battlefield, immediately remove this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** from play.

abilities.name: Knightly Exemplar
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Crypt Horrors** unit that has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability immediately after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

Set up this unit in reserve **incognito**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Bait and Switch
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is **incognito**. Pick this unit and a friendly **^^INFANTRY HERO^^** to be the targets. One target must be **incognito** and the other must be on the battlefield.
abilities.effect:
Set up the **incognito** target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat. Then, remove the other target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **incognito**.
If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly **incognito** unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.

abilities.effect: Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.

abilities.name: Scything Blade

Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** passed across during that move or that are within 1⁄2" of it to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target. In addition, when this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing.

abilities.effect: After that **^^SHOOT^^** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Mortisan Ossifector**, and add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Mortek Crawlers** picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Nullifier Auto-Endrin
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Nullifier Auto-Endrin** and is in combat with any enemy **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**, pick each enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 3D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the **banishment value** on the **^^MANIFESTATION^^**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Expendable Munitions
abilities.effect:
The following apply to this unit:
•  This unit has a maximum control score of ‘-’.
•  When this unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield, it does not count as being destroyed for the purposes of other rules (such as scoring battle tactics).
•  This unit cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-**^^CORE^^** abilities used by other friendly units unless the ability specifies **^^AUTO-ENDRIN^^**.
•  Ignore this unit for the purposes of friendly and enemy battle tactics.

abilities.name: Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Stuncloud Auto-Endrin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Stuncloud Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is equal to or lower than that target’s Health characteristic, subtract 10 from the control score of that target for the rest of the turn. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Fiery Death From Above
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **^^RETREAT^^** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **^^RETREAT^^** ability.

meleeWeapons.name: Flaming Maws and Blue Horrors’ Jabs

abilities.name: Stoked Fanaticism
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly non‑**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit each phase while it is wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

abilities.name: Extract Power
abilities.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, a **Place of Power**, or a terrain feature and that objective, **Place of Power** or terrain feature has a friendly desolation token, give this unit 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: Thrashing Desperation
abilities.effect: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot finish a charge move within ½" of a model in this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 7 or more.

abilities.name: Great Cauldron
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit’s cauldron is **filled with grisly remains**, pick a visible friendly **^^MAWSEEKERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
This unit’s cauldron is now **empty**. Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Bloodgruel***: The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fill the Pot
abilities.effect: This unit’s cauldron is either **filled with grisly remains** or **empty**. It starts the battle **empty**. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is **empty**, it becomes **filled with grisly remains**.

abilities.name: Just A Little Closer...
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to this unit, pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** next to the target.

abilities.name: Trapped!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a **trapped roll** of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll for each friendly **Mantrapper accomplice** next to the target. If the roll is less than the target’s Save characteristic, until the start of your next turn:
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
• The target does not have **^^FLY^^**.

abilities.name: Mantrapper's Accomplices
abilities.effect:
This unit’s **Sabrefang**, **Gnoblars** and **Trap** are **Mantrapper accomplice** tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all its tokens next to it.
If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to it, remove those **Mantrapper accomplices** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** uses a **^^SHOOT^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Feed On Mangled Remains
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^FIGHT^^** ability, after that **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Endless Swarm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sweeping Blows** is 3.

abilities.name: Awakening Slumbering Spirits
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token** and is within 12" of this unit. Then, pick a friendly non-**^^UNIQUE KURNOTHI^^** or **Treelord** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with 1 model from the target unit wholly within 6" of that terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, remove the friendly **overgrown token** from that terrain feature. If the target was a **Treelord**, allocate 10 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Eldest of Elders
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly **^^FOREST ELDER^^** within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for that target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Voice of Nagash
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any **non-CORE** abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Mortal Contract
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^CORE^^** ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^CORE^^** ability.

abilities.name: Elite Bodyguard
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^SKAVEN INFANTRY HEROES^^** have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are within this unit’s combat range.

name: Eternus, Blade of the First Prince

abilities.name: Veins of Black Lightning
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Network of Spies
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit is in combat with a friendly **Chaos Legionnaires** or **Chaos Furies** unit. On a 5+, that command has no effect. The command still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Barbed Arrows
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^SHOOT^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that **^^SHOOT^^** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Blood Stalkers** units picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Crucible of Rage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR^^** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Through the Frosts
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit cannot use **^^MOVE^^** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

abilities.name: Ferocious Sabrefangs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2 dice for each **Sabrefang** in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Drawn to Magic
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.
Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **^^MANIFESTATION^^** in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Drawn to War
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY HEROES^^** have **^^Ward (4+)^^** while they are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: Entropic Lodestone
abilities.effect:
From the second battle round onwards, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** units while they are wholly within 24" of this terrain feature.
If this terrain feature is wholly within 18" of the centre of the battlefield, this ability affects all friendly **^^BEASTS OF CHAOS^^** units on the battlefield instead of those wholly within 24" of it.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:
**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.
**2 -** This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
**3 -** This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^SPELLS^^**, **^^PRAYERS^^** and abilities used by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**. Otherwise, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Sacred Gongs
abilities.effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every **^^MUSICIAN^^** in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, as a reaction, you can remove a **Gong Carrier** to make an additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: Disciplined March
abilities.effect: When making run rolls for this unit, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Tallyman of Nurgle
abilities.effect:
You gain a number of **tally points** equal to the current battle round number.
During the battle round, you can spend your **tally points**. For each **tally point** you spend, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll or 1 ward roll for a friendly **^^MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
At the end of the battle round, any unspent **tally points** are lost.

abilities.name: Boing! Smash!
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase,  pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Focused Fury
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 2 to the roll if this unit is in combat.
abilities.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Champion of the Lord Phoenix
abilities.effect:
While a visible friendly **^^VANARI^^** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^HERO^^** or **^^MONSTER^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^HERO^^** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilities.name: Murderous Paragon
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Wrathmongers** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: The Slaughterborn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Myrmidon Rage
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.

abilities.name: Pit Master
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Ogroid Theridons** unit that has not used a **^^FIGHT^^** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability immediately after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^HERO^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

abilities.name: Lest You Forget...
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or CHARGE ability for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Pick 1 dice from the charge roll or casting roll for that ability. Your opponent must re-roll that dice.

abilities.name: Allow Me to Remind You...
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.

abilities.name: Spectral Alchemy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit’s shooting attacks inflicted damage on the target this turn, apply 1 of the following effects. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply 1 of the following effects:
***Phantasmal Solvent:*** If the target has a Move characteristic of'-', inflict 6 mortal damage on the target.
***Acidic Fug:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
***Fling Concoctions:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Hurled Vial this phase but all attacks made by this unit this phase must target that enemy unit.
***Choking Vapours:*** If the target is a **^^WIZARD^^**, subtract 1 from its power level until the start of your next turn.
***Fear-laced Hallucinogen:*** If the target is a **^^PRIEST^^**, remove D3 ritual points from it.
***Unholy Prescription:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Shield of Azyr
abilities.effect: While any friendly **^^THE BLACKTALONS HEROES^^** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Corrupting Influence

abilities.name: Altar of the Great Corruptor
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^PESTILENS^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Prime Cuts
abilities.effect: Each time a combat attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, give 1 **prime cut point** to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

abilities.name: Dinner is Served
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is the number of **prime cut points** this unit has. Then, reset this unit’s **prime cut points** to 0.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Noxious Vomit
abilities.effect:
If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s **Noxious Vomit**, that unit is **drenched in vomit** until the start of your next turn.
While a unit is **drenched in vomit**:
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

abilities.name: Ghostly Howl

abilities.name: The Briar Queen

abilities.name: Enshrouding Fumes
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Plague Rat
abilities.effect: This unit’s **Plague rat** is a token. If you make a unmodified chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its **Plague rat** is on the battlefield, you can remove its **Plague rat** from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.

abilities.name: Black-hearted Lackeys
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Daemonfire Pistol
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **^^HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY^^** unit in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
If there is a friendly target, for the rest of the turn:
• It can use a **^^RETREAT^^** ability and still use **^^SHOOT^^** and/or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities later in the turn. 
• Add 2" to the distance it can move when using **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on it by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Triumph or Perish, You Vermin!
abilities.effect:
While this unit has any **daemonic power points**, friendly non‑**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units, excluding **War Despots**, with 0 **daemonic power points** count as having 1 **daemonic power point** while they are wholly within 9" of and visible to this unit.
Add 3" to the range of this ability while this unit has 2 **daemonic power points**. Add 6" to the range of this ability instead while this unit has 3 **daemonic power points**.
**Designer’s Note:** *If a friendly unit with 0 daemonic power points is affected by this ability and subsequently gains 1 or more daemonic power points, this ability would stop affecting that unit. Also, Urak Taar’s ‘Master of Daemonic Power’ ability has no effect on units affected by this ability.*

abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain within 12" of this unit, give this unit a **sacrifice point**, to a maximum of 6. abilities.name: Primal Sorcery
abilities.effect:

***Warping Balefire:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
***Dark Might:***^^ ^^**Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of sacrifice points this unit has.
After applying the effect you picked, reset this unit’s **sacrifice points** to 0.

abilities.name: Mindless Ferocity
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Heads on Pikes

abilities.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^HERO^^** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy **^^HERO^^** has been destroyed, pick an objective or terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Executioner and Enforcer

abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY^^** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain. Then, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **^^FLESH-EATER COURTS^^** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Protection of the Dark Gods
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^WARRIORS OF CHAOS^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Favour of Chaos
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^SLAVES TO DARKNESS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
Apply 1 of the following effects to the target for the rest of the turn:
• ***Undivided***: When the target uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
• ***Khorne***: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick up to 2 eligible units to be the targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: No Respite
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll 2 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.effect:
Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARDS^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
In addition, this unit can use Spell abilities from the Lore of Hysh, the Lore of the Awakened Realms and the warscrolls of all friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARDS^^** on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Celennar’s Moonbright Talons** is 3.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

abilities.name: Call of the Winds
abilities.effect:
While a visible friendly **^^HURAKAN^^** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Wit of Beasts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^MONSTER^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target’s melee weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Avian Swiftness
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^ARCANITE^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn.

meleeWeapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Tripletongue’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Lord of Nurglings
abilities.effect:
While any friendly **Nurglings** units are wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that **Nurglings** unit each phase.
• That **Nurglings** unit can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.

abilities.name: Gigantic Nurgling-kin
abilities.effect: **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is half the number of damage points this unit has (rounding up).

abilities.name: Tide of Nurglings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Nurglings** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move a number of inches equal to the roll but cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

abilities.name: Trial of Skulls
abilities.effect: Add 8 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Troglodon’s Jaws** is 2.

abilities.name: Terror
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Troglodon Regeneration
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Noxious Roar
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Berserk Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Fjul's Retinue
abilities.effect: While this unit’s **Fjul-Grimnir** is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.

abilities.name: Mollog's Mob
abilities.effect: This unit’s **Bat Squig**, **Spiteshroom** and **Stalagsquig** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its tokens next to it.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Unleash The Critters!
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Spore Cloud:*** Remove this unit’s **Spiteshroom**. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
***Bat Squig Attack!:*** Remove this unit’s **Bat Squig**. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
***Rock-hard Skin:*** Remove this unit’s **Stalagsquig**. Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bitey Distractions
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** while any of its tokens are on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Blinding Bolts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by all of this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **^^MONSTER^^**. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scryhawks
abilities.effect: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Starshard Bolts** while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Vanari Auralan Sentinels** units.

abilities.name: Shrapnel Blast
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Brutal Power
abilities.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while there are any friendly **^^IRONJAWZ^^** units that have 10 or more models wholly within 12" of it.

abilities.name: Harrowing Shrieks
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Rituals of Prophecy
abilities.effect:
Roll 6 dice:
• For each 1, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
• For each 3, add 1" to this unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
• If any of the rolls are a 6, add 1 to save rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Wardroth Beetle's Antlers** is 4.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target would be destroyed by this spell, before removing any models, pick the closest terrain feature to the target that does not have a friendly **overgrown token** and give it a friendly **overgrown token**. If all terrain features on the battlefield already have a friendly **overgrown token**, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6" of the target instead.

abilities.name: Living Battering Ram
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Goddess of Life
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with 8 damage points allocated to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Lifebloom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: **Heal (2D6)** this unit.

abilities.name: Seasons of War
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round. You cannot pick the effect that you picked in the previous battle round.
***The Burgeoning:*** Each time a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** uses the ‘Ever Growing’ ability, you can pick any terrain feature your opponent does not control to be the target rather than the closest.
***The Reaping:*** Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **^^SYLVANETH^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
***The Dwindling:*** Friendly **^^SYLVANETH^^** units can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those units when they use **^^Retreat^^** abilities.
***Everdusk:*** Each time you use the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability this battle round, you can pick up to 3 targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: Cling to the Shadows
abilities.effect: While each model in this unit is within 1" of any terrain features, this unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

abilities.name: Shadowfast
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.effect: This unit can use a **^^MOVE^^** ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Swift and Nimble
abilities.effect: When this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, when determining the distance this unit can move, you can roll 2 dice instead of 1 and pick either result.

abilities.name: Transporting Vortex
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Windleap
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^HURAKAN^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use a **^^RUN^^** ability and still use **^^SHOOT^^** and/or **^^CHARGE^^** abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Titanic Duel
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy non-**^^FLY INFANTRY^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Guardian of the Glades
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^CHARGE^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the charge roll but this unit must end that charge move within ½" of an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **^^SYLVANETH HERO^^**.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Guardian Sword** is 3.

abilities.name: Iron Resilience
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not used a **^^MOVE^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Ogor Breacher
abilities.effect: While this unit includes an Ogor Breacher, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **^^KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY^^** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **^^FLY^^** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Hunt With Conviction
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** or **^^WIZARD^^** to be **hunted by the Order**. You must pick a **^^WIZARD HERO^^** if there is one in your opponent’s army.
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to the damage inflicted by this unit’s attacks that target the unit picked to be **hunted by the Order**.
**Designer’s Note:** *You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.*

abilities.name: Flamewood Stakes
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the damage inflicted (if any) on the target if it has the **DEATH**, **^^DAEMON^^** or **^^WIZARD^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Slay the Trespassers!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Magmic Tunnelling
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and any number of other units in its regiment if none of those units have been deployed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve **underground**. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Emergence
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **underground**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other units that were set up **underground** with it (if any) wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Aviarch Spymaster
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: You Dare?!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half of the units from your starting army have been destroyed.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Inda-Khaat**.
• Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **The Shield Immortis**.
• This unit cannot use the 'Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions' ability.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** keyword is 4.

abilities.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** units that have used any **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** abilities this turn.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly **^^OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** ability this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend a number of **^^relentless discipline^^** points equal to the target's Health characteristic. The target can use 2 **^^FIGHT^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use **^^RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE^^** abilities for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Spending the Forge
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS PRIEST^^** within this terrain feature’s combat range to expend the power of the forge.
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS^^** unit on the battlefield. Once this ability has been used, this terrain feature cannot use the ‘Molten Blessing’ ability for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Molten Blessing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS PRIEST^^** within this terrain feature’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target can use the ‘Unbind’ ability this turn as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

abilities.name: Arcane Engineer
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^SACROSANCT CHAMBER WAR MACHINE^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Drunken Revelry
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability if it is not in combat. It has **^^Ward (4+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fierce Guardians
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^SAURUS^^** or **^^KROXIGOR^^** units that target an enemy unit while that enemy unit is within 9" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Power Unleashed
abilities.declare: If there are any friendly **^^SERAPHON WIZARDS^^** within 3" of this terrain feature, pick another terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature, then pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If that terrain feature has a Health characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Klaq-Trok
abilities.effect: While this unit’s **Klaq-Trok** is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.

abilities.name: Kixi-Taka the Diviner
abilities.effect: While this unit’s **Kixi-Taka, the Diviner**, is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

abilities.name: Otapatl's Dartpipe
abilities.declare: If this unit’s **Otapatl** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Watery Clutch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, the target is **ensnared** for the rest of the turn.
A unit cannot use commands while it is **ensnared**.

abilities.name: Crushing Coil
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^IDONETH DEEPKIN MANIFESTATIONS^^** that target an **ensnared** enemy unit.

abilities.name: Shield of the Storm
abilities.effect: While any friendly **^^STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HEROES^^** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **^^NAMARTI^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^HERO^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Heavy-scaled Skin
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Spawn of Sotek
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^SKINK INFANTRY^^** or **^^SKINK CAVALRY^^** units in combat.

abilities.name: Graceful Leaps
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit makes a pile-in move:
• Add 3" to the distance this unit can move.
• This unit can pass through models in enemy units.

abilities.name: Star-fated Arrow
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is a non-**^^MONSTER^^** unit, inflict D6 mortal damage on it. If the target is a **^^MONSTER^^**, inflict D6+3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Spreaders of Filth and Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Draughts of Delusion
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
***Drink Deep from the Chalice:*** Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks made by the target have no effect.
***Turn Aside and Suffer the Consequences:*** Combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Arch-Manipulator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Tectonic Splintering
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Hurl Scry-orb
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Divine the Future’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Divine The Future
abilities.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the ‘Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability.

abilities.name: Honour to Grimnir!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Last of the Lodge-fire
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Rampaging Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target unit is **^^INFANTRY^^**, double the amount of mortal damage inflicted.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Razor-tipped Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Sigils of Domination
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO^^** within this unit’s combat range to be this unit’s master.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is within its master’s combat range:
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
• This unit can ignore the effects of the **Companion** weapon ability on its weapons.

abilities.name: Realmscribe
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability
abilities.effect:
Replace 1 instance of a rune on your **battle scripture** with 1 of the following:
**• Varinor, Rune of Strength**
**• Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**
**• Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**
**• Oreali, Rune of the Wind**

name: Scourge of Ghyran Auric Runeson on Magmadroth

abilities.name: Volcanic Blood
abilities.effect: If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^FIGHT^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

abilities.name: Calamitous Crash
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Fire, Blood and Vengeance
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Auric Runefather on Magmadroth** on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged or destroyed.

abilities.name: Despoilers
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared the ‘All-out Defence’ command for a unit within 6" of this unit
abilities.effect: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ferocious Advance
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.declare: This **^^MANIFESTATION^^** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3:  **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** targets can use **^^CHARGE^^** abilities even if they used a **^^RUN^^** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **^^RUN^^** abilities.
5- Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6- Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH^^** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.

abilities.name: Speed Of An Avalanche
abilities.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Sigil of Doom
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^BLADES OF KHORNE^^** unit wholly within 8" of this **^^MANIFESTATION^^** to be the target. Then, pick a passive **^^BLOOD TITHE^^** ability that you have not unlocked this battle.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the **blood tithe points** cost of the chosen ability, until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.

name: Herald of Khorne on Blood Throne

abilities.name: Offering of Blood
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit's power level, to a maximum of 2.

abilities.name: Blood Marked
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^SPELL^^** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**

abilities.name: Only The Worthy
abilities.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of models in this unit that are slain.
**1+** Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
**4+** Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**8+** Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**16+** Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons and this unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Boneshaper
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** or **Mortek Triaxes** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^HEDONITES OF SLAANESH^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target.
abilities.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Steel of Helm and Heart
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has 5 or more models, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **^^MONSTER^^**. On a 4+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **^^FIGHT^^** ability:
• This unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

abilities.name: Cinders and Ashes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit contains a **Cindergout**, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Freeguild Adjutants
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SIGMARITE^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^CITIES OF SIGMAR^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Indomitable Loreseekers
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **^^SUMMON^^** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.
Enemy **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^** cannot pass through or end any move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.
This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against mortal damage inflicted by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**.

abilities.name: Severing Strike
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

abilities.name: Protective Focus
abilities.effect: Pick a **^^SPELL^^** ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use **^^RETREAT^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: The Endless Dance
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
***The Dance of Dreaming***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
***The Pavane of Slaanesh***: This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
***The Waltz of Lethargy***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Sublime Harmonies
abilities.effect: While this unit’s **Vashtiss** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time you make a casting roll for this unit, you can spend any number of **indulgence points** it has. For each point spent, add 1 to the casting roll.

abilities.name: Indulgence Given Form
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a command while it is within 12" of this unit, give 1 **indulgence point** to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

abilities.name: Numbing Toxins

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation

abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Lithe and Swift
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.

Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.
***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.
***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Allopex’s Ferocious Bite** while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: Ensnared
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^MONSTER^^** or **^^CAVALRY^^** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Strike on the Move
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^SHOOT^^** abilities even if it used a **^^RUN^^** or **^^RETREAT^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.

abilities.name: Aetheric Augmentation
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Advisory Role
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **^^SKYFARERS^^** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
***Seek New Prospects:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.
***Don’t Argue with the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
***There’s No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **^^RETREAT^^** ability and still use **^^SHOOT^^** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **^^RETREAT^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^SKYFARER^^** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.

abilities.name: Weapon Curse
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Locus of Command
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

meleeWeapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Arcane Vassal
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^SKINK WIZARD^^** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Measure the range and visibility of the next **^^SPELL^^** ability used by this unit this phase from the target instead of from this unit.
The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’ or ‘The Earth Trembles’.

abilities.name: Dead for Innumerable Ages
abilities.effect: This unit must use this ability each turn while it is damaged. Roll 3D6 and add the number of damage points this unit has to the roll. On a 20+, this unit is destroyed. Otherwise, **Heal (18)** this unit.

abilities.name: Celestial Deliverance
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: Supreme Master of Order
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls, and add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit can use an **^^UNBIND^^** ability if an enemy **^^WIZARD^^** anywhere on the battlefield uses a **^^SPELL^^** ability instead of an enemy **^^WIZARD^^** within 30" of this unit, and when using the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, this unit can pick a manifestation anywhere on the battlefield instead of within 30" of it.

abilities.name: Earth's Grip
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is **gripped** until this unit is destroyed, the target **breaks free** or you pick a different target for this spell.
While the target is **gripped**, each time it uses a **^^MOVE^^** ability, your opponent must roll a dice as a reaction and add their **fury level** to the roll. On a 7+, the target **breaks free**. Otherwise, that **^^MOVE^^** ability has no effect.

abilities.name: Elemental Endurance
abilities.effect: If this unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, for the rest of that battle round, when resolving the damage sequence for a friendly **^^LUMINETH REALM-LORDS^^** unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool on a 2+ instead of a 3+.

abilities.name: Travel The Waterways
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
If you picked to depict **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** on your **battle scripture** this battle round, you can instead set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Relentless as the Driving Current
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units but must end that move in combat.

name: Scourge of Aqshy: Daemonsmith on Infernal Taurus

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:
**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.
**2 -** This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
**3 -** This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **^^MANIFESTATIONS^^**. Otherwise, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Leech Realm-Magic
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
• Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn.
• You can pick an objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **desolation token** and that this unit is contesting. If you do so, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle, then remove that **desolation token** from the battlefield. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Calamitous Shockwave
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is lower than your **fury level**, for the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability.
• When resolving the damage sequence for the target, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnosaur’s Massive Jaws** is 2.

abilities.name: Terror
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Spearhead of the Charge
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^SAURUS^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any damaged enemy **^^MONSTERS^^**, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Thaumaturge Hunger
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^SPELL^^** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
abilities.effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Arcane Absorption
abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^WIZARD^^** or **^^PRIEST^^** by this unit’s attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:
• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
